primitives.name: Kick Timing Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: The kick should take not more than two seconds against a strong opponent.
primitives.assumptions: Constant acceleration during kick, idealized trajectory.
primitives.breakdown_regime: t_kick > t_max implies failure of timing protocol.

layer2.mapping: Kick timing modeled as a bounded execution window with temporal fidelity to opponent reaction.
layer2.telemetry: Kick initiation to contact time difference
